text: A red check blocks the merge.
Lint and type errors are fixed first, before any further push.

Every failure gets a cause: a real bug is fixed in the PR; a test that passes only on SCC gets a skip marker for GitHub plus a register row; a flaky test gets at most one re-run, then quarantine plus a register row.
Every EF PR needs `scc-tests` = success on its head SHA: the full suite does not run on GitHub for PRs, so run `tools/scc_ci_status.py submit` and cite its job id in the PR body.
A new push needs a new submit.
A GitHub check that did not run (out of minutes, blocked) is unknown, not passed.
For `scc-tests`, `pending`, `error` and absent also mean unknown, not passed; only `success` counts.
`scc_ci_status.py sweep` turns a stuck `pending` into `error`.
Red main is reverted or fixed the same day, with no other pushes on top.
A third failed fix of the same check triggers the escalation section of plan-critique.
